# clio recall

score floors are relative filters over this query's own scores, not calibrated thresholds

## Usage

```
clio recall QUERY [--bank BANK] [--limit N] [--domains a,b] [--as-of TS] [--query-anchor TS] [--time-axis valid|transaction] [--min-semantic N] [--min-keyword N] [--min-reranker N] [--min-final N] [--no-entities] [--entity-summary] [--output json|text]
```

## Description

a score floor is a relative filter over this query's own scores, not a calibrated threshold; --min-semantic and --min-keyword prune one retrieval arm each, and --no-entities cannot be combined with --entity-summary; --query-anchor must be RFC 3339 with an explicit UTC offset, and a relative phrase without an anchor contributes nothing (no server-time fallback)

## Arguments

| Argument | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `QUERY` | yes | The query text `recall` sends to `retrieve`; it is required, and the result header echoes it back. |

## Options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--bank BANK` | text |  | Scopes the command to one bank; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and the write scope defaults to `default`. |
| `--limit N` | uint | `10` | Caps the result page; defaults to 10 when omitted; a limit above 200 is lowered to 200. |
| `--domains a,b` | text |  | Restricts retrieval to the listed domains; `cli_read_core::recall_call` splits the comma-separated value with `split_domains`. |
| `--as-of TS` | text |  | Sets the bi-temporal instant the query is evaluated at; `cli_read_core::recall_call` passes it to `retrieve` as `as_of`. |
| `--query-anchor TS` | text |  | Anchors relative time phrases in the query; `cli_read_core::recall_call` passes the RFC 3339 value to `retrieve` as `query_anchor`. |
| `--time-axis valid\|transaction` | enum: valid, transaction |  | Selects the bi-temporal axis; `cli_read_args::validate_time_axis` accepts `valid` or `transaction` for `retrieve`. |
| `--min-semantic N` | float |  | Prunes the semantic arm below this score floor; `cli_read_core::min_scores_arg` parses it with `parse_f64` for `retrieve`. |
| `--min-keyword N` | float |  | Prunes the keyword arm below this score floor; `cli_read_core::min_scores_arg` parses it with `parse_f64` for `retrieve`. |
| `--min-reranker N` | float |  | Filters the ranked page below this reranker score floor; `cli_read_core::min_scores_arg` parses it with `parse_f64`. |
| `--min-final N` | float |  | Filters the ranked page below this final score floor; `cli_read_core::min_scores_arg` parses it with `parse_f64`. |
| `--no-entities` |  |  | Suppresses entity expansion; `cli_read_core::recall_call` sends `include_entities` as false to `retrieve`. |
| `--entity-summary` |  |  | Adds the entity summary; `cli_read_core::recall_call` sends `entity_summary` as true to `retrieve`. |
| `--output json\|text` | enum: json, text |  | Selects the output mode that `cli_output::resolve_output` returns; the terminal decides it when absent. |

## Global options

| Option | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--db PATH` | text |  | Overrides the store address that `db_target::resolve_target` opens; config and environment decide it when absent. |
| `--backend sqlite\|postgres` | enum: sqlite, postgres |  | Selects the store backend that `db_target::resolve_target` hands to the resolver; config or the address decides it when absent. |
| `--actor ACTOR` | text |  | Names the acting identity; `cli_read_args::base_args` passes it to the tool and `auth_cli` reads it for the actor commands. |
| `--no-input` |  |  | Refuses interactive input; `backup_restore_cli` treats a run with it as non-interactive. |
| `--yes` |  |  | Answers yes to the destructive-confirmation gate that `cli_confirm::confirmed` applies. |

## Examples

```
clio recall "Bob lives in Canada" --db ./memory.db
```

```
clio recall "Bob lives in Canada" -o json --db ./memory.db
```

```
clio recall "Bob lives in Canada" --as-of 2026-02-01 --db ./memory.db
```
